question: Select the synonym of **Cacophony**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Discord**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cacophony"** refers to a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds; a situation marked by loud and unpleasant noise. (कर्कश ध्वनि)

 
 
• **Example: **The cacophony of the city traffic made it hard to concentrate.
 
 
 
• **"Discord"** means a lack of harmony or agreement, especially in sound or relationships. It can also refer to unpleasant or conflicting sounds. (असामंजस्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The discord between the band members led to a chaotic performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Cacophony' **is **'Discord'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Discord**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Harmony **(सामंजस्य): A pleasing combination or arrangement of different things, especially sounds.

 
 
• **Example:** The choir sang in perfect harmony, creating a beautiful melody.
 
 
 
• **Order **(व्यवस्था): A state in which everything is in its correct or proper place.
 
 
• **Example: **The librarian ensured that all books were kept in order on the shelves.
 
 
 
• **Silence** (मौन): The absence of any sound or noise.
 
 
• **Example:** The silence in the library made it easier for the students to focus.
